name: Planets
overview: Scripture reveals that the heavens, including the sun, moon, stars, and constellations such as the Pleiades and Orion, are the intentional handiwork of God, who names and sustains them by His power. These celestial bodies declare God's glory and demonstrate His sovereign control over all creation, serving as a reminder that worship belongs to Him alone rather than to the heavenly hosts. While Scripture acknowledges the vastness and order of the heavens, it also warns against idolatry by lifting eyes to these created things instead of the Creator.
